Image 1 is the APPROVED RIDER reference; preserve that identity. Image 2 is an existing mounted battle sprite STYLE and proportion reference, do NOT copy its rider. Character: Boopis. Match the approved portrait closely; preserve species, face, hairstyle, outfit colors and signature item.
Mount: a friendly horse-sized giant hare with four long steed legs, a proper saddle and a bridle. teal banner-colored saddle cloth/tack. Same rider AND same mount in ALL cells. Twins/pairs in reference ride ONE shared steed together; pets stay small companions, never extra riders. Both rider and mount always whole and uncut, feet/hooves fully visible. No standing hero beside mount except final defeat pose.
STRICT SHEET: exactly FOUR columns by SEVEN rows, 28 equal cells, every cell occupied by ONE complete mounted character. No dividers or labels. Cell content kept inside its cell with ample transparent padding. All cells same size and scale.
Rows 1 and 2: EIGHT battle poses, ALL face RIGHT/EAST, read left to right:
Row 1: idle; gallop A hooves gathered; gallop B front legs reaching; gallop C extended stride.
Row 2: gallop D rear legs reaching; attack/cast while seated; hit recoil while seated; peaceful non-graphic defeated rider slumped beside a calm standing steed.
Rows 3 through 7: MAP gallop cycles, FOUR distinct consecutive gallop frames A,B,C,D in each row. Row3 SOUTH/front toward viewer. Row4 SOUTHEAST/front-right diagonal. Row5 EAST/right full profile. Row6 NORTHEAST/back-right diagonal. Row7 NORTH/back away from viewer (show back, no face). Horse and rider turn together. Maintain consistent anatomy, size and costume. No quarter-left orientations.
Style: warm storybook low-resolution PIXEL ART, hand-placed discrete clusters, dark plum #2b1a33 outline, upper-left light, flat three-tone shading, restrained approximately24-color palette, thick readable silhouettes at48px. No smooth painting, anti-aliasing, gradients or glow. Genuine transparent alpha throughout background including spaces between legs, equipment and cells. No checkerboard, white backdrop, floor, shadows, borders, text, letters or watermarks. No armor spikes, no skull decorations on mount, no blood, no skeletal or scary steeds.
